summary: Writes the same input value a2 (passed via ECX) into three consecutive dword array elements of the object at offsets 0x58, 0x5C and 0x60 (array indices 22, 23 and 24). Unconditional straight-line execution with no guards or callees; returns the this pointer.

local_names.result: object pointer (also the return value; this base for the array writes)
local_names.a2: value written into all three array elements

operations.description: Set the dword at this+0x58 (array element 22) to a2.
Set the dword at this+0x5C (array element 23) to a2.
Set the dword at this+0x60 (array element 24) to a2.

unresolved: Meaning of the three consecutive array slots at 0x58/0x5C/0x60 is unknown; no semantic role for the triple assignment is established.
No static callers identified in the packet, so the calling context and argument source of a2 are unknown.
